nodes.label: The exchange case diverges and fails its band: total A differs at max two-sam...
nodes.statement: The exchange case diverges and fails its band: total A differs at max two-sample |z| = 12.1 (b2b_exchange_a_totals_max_z, band < 4.0), with native A ending 8.1% below the co-sim (b2b_exchange_native_minus_cosim_a_final_rel = −0.0808) and native signed mass balance at −6.8% (b2b_native_exchange_mass_balance_final_signed = −0.0681) against the co-sim's +0.51%. Two native mechanisms at the curved membrane account for it: exterior binning (1.2% of A binned to nodes outside the voxelized cell, b2b_native_exchange_a_binned_outside_cell_frac = 0.0118, so their PDE source is dropped) and a field-dependent creation deficit (Smoldyn's centre-inside test skips cells that partly overlap the curved compartment). Native fixes: re-enable the same-compartment binning correction (vcell-fvsolver#25) and draw creation in every overlapping cell.

nodes.statement: The native outer shell (r > 3.5 µm) sits 2.3% below the interior (b2c_native_shell_bias = −0.0227, z = −20.1), failing the ±1% unbiasedness band, while the co-sim shell is unbiased at +0.12% (b2c_cosim_shell_bias = 0.0012, z = 1.17). This localizes B2b's exterior-binning loss to the field next to the curved membrane: molecules binned to nodes outside the voxelized cell drop their PDE source. The native fix is to re-enable the commented-out same-compartment binning correction in VCellSmoldynOutput::computeHistogram (virtualcell/vcell-fvsolver#25).

nodes.statement: Across solvers the two SBML runs agree to within sampling: max two-sample |z| is 1.45 for A (b6_cosim_sbml_vs_native_sbml_a_max_z) and 1.14 for B, with native A ending at 3826.6 vs the co-sim's 3845.0, and native conserves A + B to +0.12% (b6_native_mass_balance_final_rel = 0.0012). The two are not bit-identical (b6_cosim_sbml_vs_native_sbml_identical = 0.0), as expected for two independent solvers of the same SBML. Reaching this needed VCell's SBML import to convert the hybrid to VCell's default units, since its spatial stochastic math is only consistent there.
